name: Crystal Ball
description: A crystal ball with different states and spawn parameters.

fields.name: State
fields.description: Defines the state of the crystal ball.

fields.name: Additional Spawn Option
fields.description: Adds spawn option 2 to the random selection.

fields.name: Spawn Option
fields.description: Selects the object or item spawned by the crystal ball. The exact meaning of each value is not fully known.

fields.name: Spawn Parameter
fields.description: Additional parameter passed to the spawned actor.

fields.name: Option Switch
fields.description: An undocumented switch checked by the crystal ball's behavior.

fields.name: Behavior
fields.description: An undocumented on/off switch checked by the crystal ball's behavior.
